description:
Position: Software Engineer - Platform / Applied AI (Full-Stack)
 Location: San Francisco, CA | Full-time | In person
 Compensation: $260,000–$290,000 + equity
 
 THE ROLE 
 Our client is looking for a Software Engineer to join their team to own core platform and data infrastructure alongside the founding team. The work spans full-stack product surfaces, desktop data-capture workflows, high-throughput pipelines, and foundational architecture. The engineer will have direct founder access and substantial responsibility for decisions that shape the growing engineering team.
  
 WHAT YOU WILL OWN 
 - Build and scale data-capture workflows across Next.js web applications and Python desktop systems.
 - Improve reliability, throughput, and performance under heavy production loads.
 - Architect data pipelines and make greenfield decisions about storage, caching, search, and message queues.
 - Establish engineering practices and scalable system patterns.
 - Work directly with the founders on product strategy and ship features quickly.
 - Take ideas from design through production and balance delivery speed with reliability.
 Requirements 
 REQUIRED TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE 
 - Full-stack JavaScript/Next.js and Python application development.
 - Strong coding fundamentals in Node.js/TypeScript, Python, and/or Go.
 - Serverless architecture and cloud functions for substantial data processing on AWS or GCP.
 - Distributed systems, scalability, system design, and clear reasoning about technical trade-offs.
 - Hands-on experience with Redis caching, Elasticsearch indexing, and Kafka, RabbitMQ, or comparable message queues.
 - Familiarity with Kubernetes, APIs, and NoSQL databases.
 - Evidence of personally getting ideas into production.
 
 NICE TO HAVE 
 - AI research, LLM evaluation, or human-in-the-loop systems.
 - AI agents or reinforcement-learning environments.
 - Founder or early engineering experience.
 
 STRONG CANDIDATE SIGNALS 
 - An active GitHub showing sustained building.
 - Ownership of production systems with measurable reliability or throughput results.
 - Experience with both user-facing software and demanding data infrastructure.
 - Proactive decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving startup work.
 - Clear motivation to work in AI operations and at an early-stage company.
 - Willingness to work the intense hours described in the hiring brief.
 Benefits 
 Compensation 
 $260,000–$290,000 + equity
 Benefits 
 Equity grant vesting over four years, health insurance, covered daily lunch and dinner, and a gym membership.
